page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB per core. Acceleration is delivered via a single integrated NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The absence of local storage and the moderate network baseline represent architectural tradeoffs that prioritize externalized data management over high-speed local disk I/O.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge offers an entry-level GPU-accelerated profile, combining a dedicated 4-core CPU allocation with a legacy NVIDIA P4 accelerator. This configuration is suited for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the overhead of high-end GPU models. Appropriate workloads include entry-level GPU-accelerated tasks, small-scale machine learning inference, video transcoding, and general-purpose compute tasks that benefit from dedicated CPU cores and moderate GPU acceleration.
